column6: The back-translation introduces 'essential' and 'power-based' categories, which alters the original meaning of 'foundational' and 'ability,' potentially changing the understanding of God's attributes. This could lead to different theological interpretations regarding the nature of God.
column7: The attributes are grouped into relational, moral, foundational, ability categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Foundational attributes describe His essential nature of being.
